what_happened: agents lost time on old tool editions named in older pages
root_cause: several pages name editions; only one is kept current
rule_now: read alarm/AGENTS.md first: it names the current editions and wins over every other page
evidence: source: lab lessons 1, 9 (reworded)

what_happened: a rule fired when a condition first turned true while the idea meant after it was done
root_cause: the definition was not read back in market words
rule_now: write each field of the definition in market words and compare it with the idea before COUNT
evidence: source: lab lesson 4

what_happened: the commonest waste was a new idea that copied an old one
root_cause: no copy search before grading
rule_now: run tried_search_v1 on the words and again with --def before COUNT; COPY or NEAR means change the idea
evidence: source: lab lessons 5, 14, 25; tried_search_v1 prints VERDICT DEF COPY

what_happened: a market-wide code read with a per-coin operator never fired, silently
root_cause: the code's scope was not read
rule_now: read each code's scope with metric_brief_v2; a market code needs the market operator
evidence: source: lab lesson 10

what_happened: fire counts looked large while the number of independent events was small
root_cause: a market-wide rule fires on many coins in one event
rule_now: count waves (any coin within 30 minutes is one event), never fires; size before you seal from inputs only
evidence: source: lab lessons 11, 12; COUNT reports waves a month

what_happened: codes with a long history window were empty in the first weeks
root_cause: the warm-up of a code was not checked
rule_now: check a code's history window and its first valued day before hand-checking a month
evidence: source: lab lesson 13

what_happened: a failed side was flipped to the other side after reading its result
root_cause: the other side was chosen with the result in view
rule_now: never flip a side after reading it: the other side is a new idea, sealed with its own reasons, and its months are already seen
evidence: source: lab lesson 18

what_happened: lines were widened to reach a wave count
root_cause: the count, not the claim, drove the setting
rule_now: never widen a line to reach a count without saying what it does to the claim
evidence: source: lab lesson 44

what_happened: new ideas were treated as right
root_cause: being new was read as evidence
rule_now: new is not right: before data, write how you would measure the forced trader and what result would prove the story wrong
evidence: source: lab lessons 38, 40, 53

what_happened: published ideas copied across timescales failed
root_cause: the source's clock, horizon and object were not stated
rule_now: every outside number states its clock, horizon and object beside ours; at another timescale take the idea, never the number
evidence: source: lab lessons 31, 41

what_happened: new screening tests stopped good ideas
root_cause: a test was used as a stop before it was run on known good and known bad cases
rule_now: a new test may stop an idea only after it passes known good cases and fails known bad ones
evidence: source: lab lessons 51, 55

what_happened: a truth label on a busy moment moved both ways
root_cause: the claim was compared only with random moments
rule_now: test a claim against its mirror on the same fires; winning a race is not being true
evidence: source: lab lessons 57, 58; true_gate_v3 needs claim minus mirror above its bar

what_happened: a broken test killed every mutant
root_cause: mutants ran before the unchanged copy passed
rule_now: a mutant run needs its unchanged copy to pass first
evidence: source: lab lesson 59

what_happened: a digest check passed on another variant's file
root_cause: a substring search, not the row of that variant
rule_now: a digest check reads the row of that variant in its column, and a missing seal that should exist is a failure
evidence: source: lab lesson 62

what_happened: held-out months were read by briefs that should not have read them
root_cause: the holdout was not a setting the tools refuse
rule_now: name build, exposed and never-read months before work starts; held-out months are opened once, on the owner's word
evidence: source: lab lessons 35, 60; law.py refuses sealed months

what_happened: the last day a metric register shows can be stale
root_cause: registers are not refreshed with every data day
rule_now: open the meaning card of each code for when it is known and how to read it; check its last valued day in the data
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 2 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: a fixed dollar line on a flow code meant different things per coin
root_cause: coins differ in size by orders of magnitude
rule_now: read a flow size against the coin own history (own percentile), not a fixed dollar line; liquidation codes are lower bounds
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 3 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: ideas without a forced trader did not hold
root_cause: a price pattern alone names no one who must trade
rule_now: start from who must trade at a known moment and why; write it on the card
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 7 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: hand checks took many slow commands
root_cause: agents searched trees instead of reading the named paths
rule_now: use the paths the pages name; where_v3 then metric_brief_v2 on 3 to 5 candidate codes only; size once with the probe
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 8, 16 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: a rule made tens of thousands of fires and was cut late
root_cause: sizing came after sealing
rule_now: size before sealing from inputs only: scale fires per coin-day to the roster and the months; raise the line, never read an outcome
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 11 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: a settle-minute rule could not reach the month wave line
root_cause: a clock with few ticks a day caps waves
rule_now: count the clock ticks a month first: under about 1.4 ticks a day cannot pass 30 waves a month
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 12, 54 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: a NEW verdict hid a copy of timing
root_cause: the novelty verdict uses same fires only
rule_now: read waves near against the baseline yourself; the same moment is a likely copy of its timing
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 14 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: a level change was a hop between levels, not a pull
root_cause: biggest-level codes can switch which level they track
rule_now: check whether a level code hopped before reading a change as a pull
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 15 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: FOLLOW ideas stopped while FADE ideas held
root_cause: more forced flow coming is usually already in the price
rule_now: a FOLLOW lean needs a reason why the move is not already priced
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 17 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: wall and depth change codes were noisy on the biggest coins
root_cause: a change code mixes pulled and traded size
rule_now: prefer a code whose meaning card says what moved (pulled vs traded)
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 19 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: COUNT is seconds, GRADE minutes
root_cause: GRADE reads every fire and its matched moments
rule_now: size the rule before COUNT and grade one variant first
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 20, 36 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: second and minute moments lost to hour-scale moments
root_cause: short moments carry less of the forced flow
rule_now: prefer moments at the scale of the forced flow; an hour of one-sided forced flow beat 30 second moments in our rounds
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 21 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: rank filters cut waves and lead; two rare events in a row were too thin
root_cause: each filter divides the sample
rule_now: a filter on an old moment is not a new alarm; a rule needing two rare events has too few waves in quiet months
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 22, 30 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: a rule with a good lead failed the bar for lack of waves
root_cause: t grows with the square root of waves
rule_now: to pass, a design needs more waves at the same lead; plan the wave count from the bar you must reach (opinion with our round numbers: about 1,000 waves at our leads)
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 23 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: the probe days hold a crash and read high
root_cause: one busy week is not a month
rule_now: size on one quiet week too; about 18 MB per derived input, stay under about 12 inputs
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 24, 39 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: the definition format has no OR
root_cause: two-sided rules need an explicit pick
rule_now: write a two-sided rule with a pick on the side, or as two variants
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 28 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: ENTRY and MONTH refused for missing inputs
root_cause: each kind needs its own files first
rule_now: ENTRY needs the sealed card copied as the alarm card; MONTH needs its forecast rows first (the queue dry run lists them)
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 29 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: alarms were judged on money
root_cause: an alarm is not a strategy
rule_now: grade an alarm on truth, newness, side and luck; money is read at the strategy stage
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 30 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: a short moment marked big moves with no side
root_cause: both sides beat random when a move is big
rule_now: read the other side gap, not only yours: a FADE where FOLLOW also wins is a size reading
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 32, 33 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: useful codes were missed
root_cause: only the value rows were searched
rule_now: search every family with where_v3 --kind metric and read each with metric_brief_v2; not every code passes the COUNT gate
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 34, 37 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: forced-trader links were inferred, never measured
root_cause: no measure was planned
rule_now: before data, write how you would measure the forced trader and what result would prove the story wrong
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 38, 40 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: tools failed with the system python
root_cause: the system python lacks the packages
rule_now: always run the PYTHON of the settings file
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 39 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: COUNT waves read above graded waves
root_cause: waves with no matched random moment are not graded
rule_now: aim about 10 percent above the wave bar at COUNT
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 39 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: a dose test hid a price test inside the load
root_cause: compound loads mix conditions
rule_now: run each condition of a compound load alone, with the placebo under the same conditions; planted tests must hold empties
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 50 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: a measure gate stopped good ideas
root_cause: the gate was not tested on known good and known bad cases
rule_now: a new test may stop ideas only after it passes known good and fails known bad cases; measure the story and print it on the card, then grade
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 42, 46, 51, 55 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: follow claims beyond a quarter hour failed
root_cause: one-way forced flow lasted 5 to 15 minutes on our moments
rule_now: no FOLLOW claim beyond the measured flow length
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 48 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: stock was read as exposure
root_cause: no leverage or equity data; fresh open interest is mostly churn
rule_now: do not read stock as exposure until margin data exists
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 49 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: a settings word did not split in zsh
root_cause: zsh does not split variables
rule_now: write --settings and the path as two words
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 45 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: reading claims of papers that were not read
root_cause: no PDF reader on the machine
rule_now: say what was read (abstract, HTML) and never quote what was not read
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 47 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: winning a race was read as being true
root_cause: the race and the truth test ask different questions
rule_now: fix the words before the run and say which test is the gate; a true event can lose its race
evidence: source: the lab alarm lessons page, lesson 58 (agent school rounds 0 to 10, Oct-Nov 2026; reworded, names of seats, paths and found alarms removed)

what_happened: the link to the machine dropped, or the shell cut a long job call, in the middle of desk work; the agent then could not tell which commands had run, worst when one call carried several state-changing commands, and a blind re-run could queue a job twice
root_cause: the connection, not the desk; nothing told the agent to read the state before re-running
rule_now: send one state-changing desk command per call; after a drop or a cut call, wait with short checks and retry, then read the state before re-running anything (the run's RUNS.tsv, <run>/receipts/<job>/STAGES.tsv of the newest job, the register tail, the run log, and with a bridge its newest job and log); a job whose STAGES.tsv exists was queued: wait for it, never queue it again; a dry run writes nothing and may be re-run
evidence: source: five desk tries' tool lessons on lost links and cut calls, 2026-11-04 (reworded; seats and job numbers removed)
